query:
MATCH (t:Transcript)-[:INFLUENCES]->(c:Company) WHERE EXISTS { (t)-[:HAS_PREPARED_REMARKS]->(:PreparedRemark) } AND EXISTS { (t)-[:HAS_QA_EXCHANGE]->(:QAExchange) } AND NOT EXISTS { (t)-[:HAS_QA_SECTION]->(:QuestionAnswer) } AND NOT EXISTS { (t)-[:HAS_FULL_TEXT]->(:FullTranscriptText) }
WITH c,count(DISTINCT t) AS transcripts
CALL (c) { OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Report)-[:PRIMARY_FILER]->(c)
 WHERE r.formType='10-K' AND r.periodOfReport IS NOT NULL
 WITH r ORDER BY r.periodOfReport DESC
 LIMIT 3
 RETURN collect({accession:r.accessionNo,period:r.periodOfReport,created:r.created}) AS annuals }
RETURN c.ticker AS ticker,c.cik AS cik,c.fiscal_year_end_month AS stored_month,transcripts,annuals ORDER BY ticker

redis_check.action: No further connection retries or service changes in this bounded task.

limits: Annual metadata is a consistency check, not exact fiscal-window certification. A month mismatch can reflect week calendars or a changed calendar, not necessarily wrong data. No original filing body or fiscal-year naming was independently verified here; no future quarter dates certified.
